review_comments.body: This guard accepts `support+app@example.com`, but [Aliyun’s documented `ReplyAddress` character set](https://help.aliyun.com/en/direct-mail/singlesendmail) excludes `+` and lists `InvalidReplyAddress.Malformed` for invalid values. Could we apply the provider’s validation before sending so an unsupported reply-to value does not prevent delivery?

comments.body:
Thanks for the review. Applied in eff20ce: `replyTo` is now validated against the characters Aliyun accepts for ReplyAddress (letters, digits, `_`, `.`, `-` in the local part, then `@domain`) instead of `emailGuard`, which also accepts `+`. I added a test with `support+app@...` that fails with `emailGuard` and passes now.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
